desc:
🎃 Don't Let Them Find You!

MONSTERS
🎩 Cat in the Hat
🔴 Thing 1 & Thing 2
⚫ Room (Monochrome)
⚫ Eyes & Dish

TRAPPED inside a school after DARK, you wander the empty halls and REALIZE... you are NOT ALONE.

SEARCH classrooms, explore the SCHOOL, and gather the tools you need to BANISH the MONSTERS from our world.

But be careful — THE CAT IN THE HAT knows a lot about THAT...

CONTROLS
Run — Shift
Crouch — Ctrl / C
Slide — Shift + C
Pick Up / Interact — E
Jump — Space
Flashlight — F

⭐ Favorite the game and 👍 Like it if you enjoy it!
